scope: 24 purposively sampled public biographies; 18 development and 6 original holdout. Fresh holdout not opened. Synthetic counterexamples defined but not executed by this review.
importantDistinction: A plausible discovery option can still have an overstated specific-support claim. Relevance labels here concern exploration, not validated career suitability or professional readiness.
globalFindings: The leading directions are generally coherent, but several branch-specific labels rest on inherited profile-inferred answers whose rationales call the transfer untested. This is evidence provenance/calibration risk, not a reason to hide those careers.
The 12-slot global window can repeat a family and bury distinct directly supported directions. This review cannot infer whether hidden careers are accessible elsewhere.
Every packet candidate has an empty contrary array. That does not prove absence of conflicting interest; it limits this reviewers ability to validate negative-evidence handling.
No confirmed stereotype-driven veto can be established from these static outputs. Mental health or access requirements should continue to affect support and practical context only where relevant.
Field-survey scope fidelity, live interactions, added-answer responsiveness, fresh-holdout performance, external-service agreement and before/after gains are not assessed by this packet.
